summary: Almonty Industries filed a Form 6-K press release providing an operational update on its large-scale drilling program at the Sangdong Molybdenum Project in South Korea. The drilling aims to confirm molybdenum resource grades ahead of future development, with 37% of 26 planned drill holes completed. Assays show grades consistent with historical data. No specific deal terms, prices, or financial arrangements were disclosed. The filing is a routine progress report on exploration activities, not a special situation transaction.
